title: Notice of Award to Christian Freire Coello for the operation of a mobile truck at Webster Playground
agency_path: City of New York > Parks and Recreation
description_text: The City of New York Department of Parks & Recreation ('Parks') has awarded a concession to Christian Freire Coello, of 1467 Arnow Ave, Bronx, NY 10469 for the operation of a processing mobile truck for the sale of Parks approved items at Webster Playground: Playground on E188th near the Basketball court, Bronx. The concession, which was solicited by a Request for Bids, will operate pursuant to a permit agreement for one (1) five (5) year term.  Compensation to the City will be as follows: Year 1: $1,000; Year 2: $1,050; Year 3: $1,102; Year 4: $1,157; Year 5: $1,215.
